rows.title_short: \" Comprehensive Renal Replacement Therapy Act \"
rows.abstract:
Aims to make comprehensive renal replacement therapy services available to all Filipinos who suffer from End Stage Kidney Disease; supports kidney transplantation as the best treatment option that provides the highest quality of life for End Stage Renal Disease patients and ensures the return of the patient to full rehabilitation.  
Provides for the expansion of PhilHealth benefit package for kidney transplantation or renal replacement therapy from both the living and deceased donors; provision of free dialysis to indigent patients; and provision by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office of the remaining sessions for both peritoneal dialysis and hemodialysis after a patient has already consumed his or her benefit package from PhilHealth.

AN ACT INSTITUTING THE MEDICAL RESERVE CORPS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS
THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to establish a Medical Reserve Corps which shall be composed of all persons who have degrees in the field of medicine, nursing, medical technology, and other health-related fields but have yet to have their respective licenses to practice.
Provides that these Members may be called upon and mobilized to: assist the National and LGUs in their functions related to addressing the medical needs of the public in times of national or local emergencies; and to respond to contingencies related to external and territorial defense, internal security and peace and order and/or disaster risk reduction management.
Provides also for an evaluation of the requests for deployment, which shall contain its justification and information such as the nature of the contingencies to be addressed, the purpose of the deployment, the number of personnel requested and the period of deployment.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMOTING THE ENVIRONMENTALLY SOUND MANAGEMENT OF E-WASTE IN THE PHILIPPINES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Defines several terms which includes \"E-Waste\" which shall refer \"to old, end-of-life or discarded appliances that use electricity and other electrical and electronic equipment which have been disposed of by their original users\".
Seeks to ensure that e-waste management is accomplished in an environmentally sound manner that adheres to the principles and agreements in which the country is a signatory and has committed compliance, as follows:
a. the Basel Convention, which controls the transboundary movement and disposal of hazardous wastes;
b. the principle of “extended producer´s/distributor´s responsibility”; and 
c. the Basel Ban Amendment, which prohibits the transboundary movement of hazardous waste from developed to developing countries.
Proposes several provisions as regards to the responsibilities of the national and local government and recyclers; and recycler's registration program, among others.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN ECONOMIC STIMULUS STRATEGY FOR THE COUNTRY'S GROWTH AND DEVELOPMENT IN THE AFTERMATH OF COVID-19, AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: " Accelerated Recovery And Investments Stimulus For The Economy Of The Philippines " Or A R I S E Philippines Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to provide immediate relief to critically impacted businesses and non-essential businesses to reduce permanent damage to the economy, maintain employment levels and have a demonstrable capacity to support economic output and preserve the country´s productive capacity.

Provides four types of Economic Interventions such as: a. Transitional Interventions - mitigate the permanent damage by the Covid-19 crisis to the economy and maintain employment levels of the corresponding sector or industry; b. Financial Interventions - intended to accelerate recovery and improve economic performance of business entities by broadening and increasing financial and credit access; c. Sectoral - economic relief intended for specific sectors or industries; and d. Structural - measures designed to accommodate, close gaps in, or impose any sector or industry through an institutionalized mechanism or entity.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2020-06-04, transmitted to the Senate on 2020-06-08 and received by the Senate on 2020-06-08

rows.title_short: \" Covid-19-related Anti- Discrimination Act \"
rows.abstract:
Seeks to grant the full, inviolable protection against prejudice and discrimination to those who have already suffered and recovered from Covid-19 disease and value the dignity of every person and guarantee full respect of their human rights.

Enumerates and penalizes discriminatory practices against persons who are declared confirmed, suspect and probable cases of COVID-19 or any person suspected of having been exposed to and has recovered from COVID-19, including Filipino workers, registered or otherwise such as: a. Failure to Give Assistance; b. Harassment or Assault; c. Stigmatization; and d. Unlawful Refusal to Honor Valid and Existing Contracts.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING POLICIES, REGULATIONS, AND PUBLIC HEALTH SAFEGUARDS FOR THE BETTER NORMAL IN THE WORKPLACE, PUBLIC PLACES AND COMMUNITIES TOWARD A SUSTAINABLE RECOVERY FROM COVID-19 PANDEMIC
rows.title_short: " Better Normal For The Workplace, Communities And Public Spaces Act Of 2020 "
rows.abstract:
Seeks to provide the strategies and measures that shall be implemented so that economic and social activities can proceed in a manner that ensures public health, safety, and security during an epidemic, and until such time that the same is declared eradicated by the authorized National Government agency or agencies of the government.Mandates the LGUs to be primarily responsible for instituting localized policies and legislation in accordance with the better normal measures and other directives and issuances of the National Government.

Prescribes all private businesses, offices and establishments to submit a Management Plan to the concerned LGU where the entity conducts operations or holds office not later than (15) days upon resumption of their operations.

Provides specific responsibilities of the following National Government Offices, their respective Attached Agencies, and GOCCs: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT), Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), Department of Health (DOH), Local Water District and Water Utilities, Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), and Department of Finance (DOF).

Enumerates prohibited acts and omissions and its corresponding penalties under this Act.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2020-08-10, transmitted to the Senate on 2020-08-11 and received by the Senate on 2020-08-19

rows.title_short: " Crushing Covid-19 Act "
rows.abstract:
Aims to safeguard the people from the threat of Covid-19 pandemic by requiring them to undergo testing for early detection and proper management.

Establishes the Baseline Polymerase Chain Reaction Testing, or Baseline PCR Testing as the protocol for Covid-19 testing for the vulnerable members of the society.

Mandates the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) to cover the full cost of testing, including the cost of services of the pathologist, laboratory specialist and other laboratory staff which shall not be more than the prevailing market cost.

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ENHANCE INTER-LGU COOPERATION BY AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISIONS IN BOOK I OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991”
rows.abstract:
States that LGUs may group themselves, consolidate, or coordinate their efforts, services, and resources for purposes commonly beneficial to them THROUGH MUTUAL AGREEMENT OR THROUGH THE FORMATION OF AN ALLIANCE WITH A LEGAL PERSONALITY.

Provides that a National Registry of Alliances ( N R A ) shall be formed to register the alliance of LGUs and establish the legal personality and all the consequent implications of the same.

Refers Inter-Local Cooperation to the arrangement wherein geographically adjacent local government units (LGUs) agree to jointly plan and implement development projects, programs, and initiatives.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2020-06-01

rows.author: D013
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ENHANCE PUBLIC FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT BY AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISIONS IN BOOK II OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991”
rows.abstract:
Intends to: 1) integrate principles and policies of good governance and efficient public financial management; 2) mandates relevant government agencies to provide proper guidance to the LGU´s in planning, investment programming, budgeting, revenue mobilization and administration, expenditure management, performance monitoring, and management including the preparation of public investment plans.

Emphasizes the role of Regional Development Councils as well as the provincial, city, and municipal governments over their respective component LGUs in matters of public finance management.

Provides for the digitization of reports and posting on government portals to ensure transparency and accountability.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2020-06-01
